page.title: Settings
page.description: Customize the appearance and behavior of the application.

keybindings.title: Keybindings
keybindings.description: View and customize keyboard shortcuts. Click a row to reassign.

workspace.title: Workspace Folder
workspace.description: Select a local folder to use as your workspace. Diagrams will be read from and saved to this directory.

tabsBehavior.title: Tab Behavior
tabsBehavior.allowCloseLastTabDescription: When enabled, closing the last open tab shows the welcome screen instead of keeping the tab open.

ai.title: AI Configuration
ai.description: Configure AI providers and API keys for diagram assistance.

provider.title: AI Provider
provider.description: Choose which AI provider to use for diagram assistance.

model.title: Model
model.customHelp: Select one from the list or type any model manually.

codex.title: ChatGPT / Codex
codex.description: Connect your ChatGPT Plus/Pro account through the local gateway. Tokens are kept outside the webview.
codex.browserOpenFailed: Could not open the browser automatically
codex.completeInBrowser: Complete login in the browser. If it shows a callback URL, paste it here.
codex.waitingForCode: Waiting for the authorization code or callback URL from the browser.
codex.manualCodeDescription: Paste the authorization code or full callback URL shown by the browser.

customInstructions.title: Custom Instructions
customInstructions.description: These instructions are appended to every AI request. Use them to set persistent preferences like language, style, or constraints.
customInstructions.placeholder: Example: Always respond in Spanish. Use blue as the primary color for shapes.

toolConfirmation.title: Require confirmation for write tools
toolConfirmation.description: Show a permission dialog before the AI modifies documents or diagrams.
toolConfirmation.enabledHint: The AI will ask before modifying documents or diagrams.
toolConfirmation.disabledWarning: The AI can modify documents and diagrams without asking.

markdownEditor.title: Markdown editor
markdownEditor.description: Editor used to open .md files. Rich notes (.note) always use the rich editor. Applies to files opened from now on.
markdownEditor.classicHint: Block editor. Converting to Markdown can lose formatting.
markdownEditor.markdownHint: Plain Markdown with live preview, / commands, [[ links, diagrams and formulas. Saves exactly what you write.
